title: VSS container release set
description: One complete, immutable set of container images for a VSS source commit. The manifest — not a moving tag — is the source of truth: acceptance tests run against exactly these digests, and the weekly NGC promotion copies the same digests without rebuilding. Produced by .github/scripts/release_set.py assemble.

release_set_id.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of this document with release_set_id set to the empty string. Immutable identity for the acceptance handoff.

name.description: Logical name; must exist in deploy/docker/container-inventory.json.

strategy.description: build: built from this repo for this set. mirror: copied from an approved upstream digest. reuse-pinned: unchanged component explicitly carried forward at its current pinned coordinate (never silently absent).

tag_suffix.description: Variant suffix applied to immutable, content-addressed, and moving tags. Empty for the default image variant.

digest.description: Manifest-list digest. Required (non-null) for strategy=build and strategy=mirror; may be null for reuse-pinned entries until the mirror program (I-07) resolves them.

source_tree_sha.description: git rev-parse <commit>:<source_path> — the TREE hash the container-source gate compares, not the commit SHA.

upstream_digest.description: For mirror strategy: the source-registry digest the copy was verified against.
